name: Five Errands for the Devil — Color Palette
notes: Machine-readable export of the art bible §4. Status: PINNED = user-approved via a recorded decision (D-ORCH-02, 2026-11-15); PLACEHOLDER = legal through the greybox MVP, PINNED required before content ship (SYS-09 TR-DR-002); RESERVED = not a table member. OKLCH (L 0-1, C 0-0.4, h deg) is the source of truth; hex is the 8-bit sRGB encoding, round-trip verified. Derived shades (coursing -0.05 L, print inks, rim tones) are computed per surface, never stored as members.

variants.name: The Cistern reveal set — one geometry, two palettes
variants.rule: The isomorphism law: same slot list, same placements; a re-skin is a table swap over unchanged coordinates. tileset_cistern_a/b ship as a same-dimension pair.

variants.name: The liminal wing — neither truth
variants.rule: Epoch-invariant; greys own seam space; the ramp is the only light model; the grief tint at M4's anchor is the sole hue.

tests.two_second_truth: A cold viewer names the reality (A cold-tech / B warm-gothic) from a still in under 2 seconds, no caption
tests.hue_swap_survival: Recolor each set's glow to the other's temperature; A must still read machine, B must still read crafted
tests.value_zoning: Entities >= 2 value-ramp steps clear of every backdrop member of their frame's truth
tests.gap_check: Ramp quantized gaps 0.098 / 0.110 / 0.109 >= 0.09 (D-ORCH-02 verified; no fallback triggered)
